physics_goals.quote: The A' Experiment (APEX) will search for a new vector boson A' with very weak coupling to electrons in the mass range from 65 MeV to 550 MeV.
physics_goals.value: Search for a new vector boson A' (dark photon) with very weak coupling to electrons in the mass range from 65 MeV to 550 MeV

summary.plain: APEX searched for a hypothetical 'dark photon' by firing Jefferson Lab's electron beam at a heavy target and looking for a narrow bump in the mass of electron-positron pairs. A short 2010 test run set the first limits; a longer run followed in 2019.
summary.technical: Fixed-target search for a sub-GeV vector boson A' decaying to e+e- using the Hall A high-resolution spectrometers at their minimum opening angle on a thin high-Z target: test run in 2010 (2.26 GeV, limits alpha'/alpha ~ 1e-6 for 175-250 MeV) and a production run in 2019 (2.138 GeV) whose analysis was reported preliminarily in a 2022 thesis.
